scope: Offline bake of the 144 sequences of eight CMC Dense databases from UEFN onto the Lyra SK_Mannequin, plus an isolated Motion Matching pilot. Pivots, sprint, crouch, jumps, lands, traversal, Mover and existing pawns are out of scope.

deviations.setting: ik_foot_root and ik_hand_root from root, ik_foot_l/r from foot_l/r, ik_hand_l/r from hand_l/r, ik_hand_gun from hand_r; target skeleton, global position and rotation
deviations.reason: The official op stack leaves IK bones in the reference pose; the source clips keep them on the FK bones, and the copied AnimBP consumes them.
The batch evaluates source poses with root motion in the pose; global scaling moved the root 3.3 % further per metre than the blend-to-source feet.
The same drift for the pelvis; vertical motion stays scaled as at runtime.

presentation_mesh.note: Copy of the Lyra SKM_Manny_Simple with the grey GASP MI_Manny_01/02 materials; same LOD0 geometry and skeleton. Used by the Manny pilot pawn and the follower profile. The Phase C follower capture used the original Lyra mesh.

modified_existing_assets.change: Added blend profiles FastFeet+Root_Weight and FastHead_Weight, copied by bone name from SK_UEFN_Mannequin; approved by the user on 2026-10-11. Rollback reverts this file.

pose_assets.note: Two blendspaces and their 18 additive pose sequences, needed by the copied AnimBP; additive types and reference poses are preserved.

composition_assets.map_base: /Game/SurvivalRpg/Maps/Test/Lvl_RpgGaspMantle without traversal obstacles and with one PlayerStart

metrics.preservation: 144/144 identical length, frame count, root-motion flags, rate scale, curve names and values, and 1295 notifies; no sync markers in source or bake

evidence: Raw files under Saved/Gasp08 and Saved/Profiling/CSV of the producing checkout; not versioned.
